name: eCommerce Starter
description: An Onyx-backed storefront and store desk with products, carts, inventory, orders and optional hosted checkout.
useWhen: A small online store needs a self-hosted full-stack application with Onyx persistence
avoidWhen: A high-volume or multi-currency marketplace is required
capabilities: Guest and verified customer carts and orders
Optional Stripe Checkout and signed webhooks
React Email preview outbox and optional SMTP
notIncluded: Live constrained-inventory checkout without additional verification

requiredEnvironment: Application Firebase configuration and administrator grant
Explicit demo or Stripe checkout mode
